remarks: Welcome to 3607 112 Avenue NW in Beverly Heights! This brand new, never occupied 2 storey home offers just under 2000 sq ft above grade with 4 bedrooms and 3 full baths. The main floor features 10 ft ceilings, a bright living room with an electric fireplace, a dining area, an open kitchen with pantry, a mud room, plus a main floor bedroom and full 3-piece bath, ideal for guests, extended family or a home office. Upstairs you will find 3 bedrooms, including the primary bedroom with walk-in closet and 3-piece ensuite, a front bedroom with its own walk-in closet and balcony, plus a 4-piece bath and convenient upper floor laundry. A separate entrance leads to the full unfinished basement with 9 ft ceilings, ready for your future development ideas. A double detached garage off the back lane completes the package. The seller is also offering a $5,000 appliance credit. Close to schools, parks, the river valley trails, transit and quick access to downtown. (id:67522)
courtesy: Raj Khosah, Exp Realty and Chelsey Maves-Prychitko, Exp Realty
